summary: Full backend+frontend testing of new Inline Price Edit feature (Daftar Harga). 15/15 backend pytest cases pass for PATCH /api/products/{id}/price and /api/bundles/{id}/price (set/unset channel, negative=>400, kasir=>403, 404, bundle harga_beli=>400). Frontend Playwright: admin can inline edit beli/normal/reseller/channel via click->input, Enter saves (toast 'Harga diperbarui'), blur saves, Escape cancels, channel=0 shows 'belum diatur', 'bersih Rp...' displayed. Bundle inline edit works. Kasir sees price cells as plain text (0 -edit buttons). Pencil form regression OK.
critical_code_review_comments: PriceCell: Number(val)||0 means empty input becomes 0 silently; acceptable for channel (removes) but for harga_beli/jual/reseller empty-string also saves as 0 which may be unintended UX.
Backend _price_update: field 'channel' with value < 0 passes the negative check only before channel validation; fine but when value == 0 unset works - good.
DaftarHarga setPrice always does api.patch and load; could optimistically update to avoid flashing full table reload. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test product created via UI during admin flow and deleted at end. Bundle 'Pupuk' price edited then restored to original Rp 600.000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inline price edit backend endpoints and UI are stable. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_inline_price_edit.py for regression.
